description: Adds a media clip from the project panel to a sequence timeline at a specific track and time.

insertMode.description: Whether to overwrite existing content or insert and shift

linkAudio.description: When false, removes the auto-linked audio counterpart that Premiere places on audio tracks for video-track clips. Useful for video overlays whose source media (e.g. Remotion .mov outputs) carry silent PCM that would overwrite existing audio. Default true (preserves Premiere's native linking behavior).

projectItemId.description: The ID of the project item (clip) to add

sequenceId.description: The ID of the sequence (timeline) to add the clip to. Defaults to the active sequence.

sourceInPoint.description: Source IN point in seconds — the start of the sub-range to pull from the source (footage or sequence). Replicates marking an in point in the Source monitor. Requires sourceOutPoint. When omitted, the whole source (or its current marks) is placed.

sourceOutPoint.description: Source OUT point in seconds — the end of the sub-range to pull from the source. Replicates marking an out point in the Source monitor. Requires sourceInPoint.

time.description: The time in seconds where the clip should be placed on the timeline

trackIndex.description: The index of the video or audio track (0-based)

name: add_to_timeline
